reading.body:
CyrusOne's San Antonio campus publishes 33 MW of IT capacity across 175,000 square feet, ranking sixth among Texas facilities that disclose power figures and representing 6.9% of the state's 475 MW of published data center IT load.

At standard AI training density of 40 kW per rack, this capacity would support roughly 825 racks. At 100 kW per rack for GPU-dense inference, it would support roughly 330 racks. The facility's actual workload mix remains unknown from published sources. The certifications—SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, FISMA, and TIA-942—indicate the campus is architected for regulated enterprise and government workloads rather than signaling AI infrastructure specifically.

Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities but only 19 publish IT capacity figures. This campus is among the disclosed nineteen. The gap between mapped count and published count means the state's actual installed capacity is unknown. Texas power data covers only a fraction of the facilities that exist, so any ranking or market share figure derived from disclosed sites is incomplete.
